correctness.evidence: Independent enumeration of all connected unlabeled graphs on 5–7 vertices (986 total) and an independent Hochster-homology/induced-matching computation reproduced the regularity distributions, the 286 distinct Betti tables, and all 48 reg−indmatch=1 cases.

originality.evidence: The exact n≤7 aggregate appears narrowly distinct from the checked literature; however, the ingredients are standard and closely related work already studies regularity, induced matchings and Betti tables of edge ideals (e.g. arXiv:1412.3881 and arXiv:2108.07304).

scientific_value.evidence: The surviving contribution is an arbitrary small finite census using established invariants and methods. It supplies neither a theorem, a new regime, a reusable algorithmic advance, nor a structural explanation beyond n≤7, so it does not meet the campaign’s scientific-value threshold.

decision: Rejected: at least the scientific-value axis fails the campaign threshold.
